full_judgment: 8. Reference may also be made to another earlier single Bench decision of the Dacca High Court reported in 16 D L.R. 45 vide paragraph 16, 17, and 18 thereof wherein it was held that the right of presumption under Muslim Law arises only out of a valid complete and bonafide sale and the Talab-i-Mowasibat is of no effect if it be made before the completion of the sale. The decision in question does not, of course, specify as to when a sale is deemed to be complete under Muslim Law and whether section 54 of the Transfer of Property Act has superseded the Muslim Law of pre-emption to that extent.
